stories.title: Pakistan'da sıcak saatler: Başkent dev konteynerlarla kapatıldı

en.title: Tense hours in Pakistan: Capital sealed off with large containers
en.summary: Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf planned a protest march in the capital demanding the release of former Prime Minister Imran Khan, leading authorities to seal off the city with containers.

stories.title: Yapay zekada biyoloji devrimi: AlphaFold veri tabanına 8 bin virüs proteini eklendi

en.title: Biology revolution in artificial intelligence: 8,000 virus proteins added to AlphaFold database
en.summary: The UK-based Bioinformatics Institute released over 8,000 protein complexes from 23 virus families, including mpox, measles, and hepatitis B, predicted by the AlphaFold2 artificial intelligence tool.

stories.title: Türkiye-Fransa maçı dünya basınında! 'Arda Güler, karşılığını alamadı'

en.title: Turkey-France match in world media! 'Arda Güler went unrewarded'
en.summary: Turkey's national football team lost 1-0 to France in their first UEFA Nations League match, with leading international media outlets covering the game.

en.title: Fortune emerges from Kara Haydar's parking lot
en.summary: An investigation in Ankara regarding Mehmet Fatih Tançalan, known as Van's "Kara Haydar", uncovered significant valuables at a parking facility.

stories.title: SON DAKİKA | Sivas’taki sır olayda kan donduran detaylar! 11 aylık Büşra bebek nerede?

en.title: BREAKING | Chilling details in the mysterious case in Sivas! Where is 11-month-old Büşra baby?
en.summary: An 11-month-old baby named Büşra Balıkçı has been missing in Sivas for 16 days with no news. Investigation teams are searching for the child while significant developments continue to emerge in the case.

stories.title: Vanlı Kara Haydar'ın araçlarından servet çıktı: 934 milyon değerinde dövize el konuldu

en.title: Fortune found in vehicles of Van's Kara Haydar: 934 million in foreign currency seized
en.summary: Turkish authorities seized 934 million Turkish lira in foreign currency hidden in two vehicles parked in Sarıyer Maslak during an investigation into Mehmet Fatih Tançalan, known as Kara Haydar. One person was detained in connection with the operation.

stories.title: SON DAKİKA... Başsavcılık 7 fonun tüm kayıtlarını istedi

en.title: BREAKING... Chief Prosecutor requests all records of 7 funds
en.summary: The scope of financial examination in a fund investigation has been expanded. Prosecutors have requested records from seven portfolio management companies whose funds were subject to liquidation decisions.

stories.title: Sivas'ta kaybolan 11 aylık Büşra bebek için arama çalışmaları sürüyor

en.title: Search continues for 11-month-old Büşra baby missing in Sivas
en.summary: Search operations for 11-month-old Büşra Balıkçı, missing in Divriği district, are ongoing using AI-assisted drones and specially trained dogs. Six people, including the child's parents, have been arrested, but teams have found no evidence of the baby yet.

stories.title: Avrupa basınında gündem Türkiye - Fransa maçı: 'Galip geldi ancak Mbappe'yi kaybetti'

en.title: European press focus on Turkey - France match: 'Won but lost Mbappe'
en.summary: Turkey's national team lost 1-0 to France in their opening UEFA Nations League A Group 1 match. The game received significant coverage in French media.

stories.title: Son Dakika... Fon soruşturmasında yeni gelişme: Savcılık 7 fonun tüm kayıtlarını istedi

en.title: New development in fund investigation: Prosecutor's office requests all records of 7 funds
en.summary: Istanbul's chief prosecutor's office has requested complete records from the establishment of 7 funds to the present, along with all transactions from June, July, and August.

stories.title: Kiralık sosyal konutta başvuru süreci tamamlandı! Bakan Kurum duyurdu: İncelemeler başladı

en.title: Application process completed for rental social housing! Minister Kurum announced: Examinations have begun
en.summary: The environment minister announced that the application phase for TOKİ's rental social housing project has concluded, with examination phase proceeding before a lottery selection process begins.

stories.title: Kiralık sosyal konutta başvuru süreci tamamlandı

en.title: Application process completed for rental social housing
en.summary: The environment minister announced completion of the application phase for TOKİ's rental social housing project, with examinations to follow before moving to the lottery stage.

stories.title: ICICI Bank altın için tarih verdi: Önce 4.600 dolar, ardından 5.000 dolar

en.title: ICICI Bank sets timeline for gold: First 4,600 dollars, then 5,000 dollars
en.summary: ICICI Bank expects gold to trade sideways in the near term following September's sharp correction, projecting prices between 4,200-4,600 dollars through 2026 and potentially reaching 5,000 dollars in the first half of 2027.

stories.title: Trump İran'ın 7 günlük teklifini reddetti: Seçim sonrası saldırı seçeneği masada

en.title: Trump rejects Iran's 7-day proposal: Post-election military action on the table
en.summary: Iran's seven-day ceasefire proposal involving reopening the Strait of Hormuz was rejected by President Trump, with the United States refusing to lift its naval blockade and military strikes against Iran becoming a possibility after November elections.

stories.title: Türkiye'ye sürdürülebilir turizm ödülü: 2 bin 500'ü aşkın tesis sertifika aldı

en.title: Turkey wins sustainable tourism award: Over 2,500 facilities certified
en.summary: Turkey's Tourism Promotion and Development Agency won the inaugural "Destination for Change" award at the 2026 TTG Travel Industry Awards in England, with over 2,500 accommodations receiving international sustainability certification.

stories.title: Kara Haydar operasyonunda iki otomobilden 16,4 milyon Euro ve 700 bin dolar çıktı

en.title: Kara Haydar operation: 16.4 million euros and 700,000 dollars seized from two vehicles
en.summary: During an operation in Istanbul's Sarıyer district targeting Mehmet Fatih Tançalan, authorities recovered 16.4 million euros and 700,000 dollars hidden in two vehicles, equivalent to approximately 934 million Turkish lira, with one suspect detained.

stories.title: Nordex Türkiye'den alımı 1 milyar Euroya çıkardı: 70 milyon Euro daha yatırdı

en.title: Nordex raised Turkey purchases to 1 billion euros: invested additional 70 million euros
en.summary: German wind turbine manufacturer Nordex increased its annual product and equipment procurement from Turkey to 1 billion euros, while planning a 70 million euro investment in 2026 and targeting a significant share in October's 1,500 MW renewable energy tender.
